dietary.veganDesc: No animal products at all — no meat, fish, dairy, or eggs.

dietary.glutenFreeDesc: No wheat, rye, barley, or regular oats.
dietary.dairyFreeDesc: No milk or milk-based products, including butter, cheese, and cream.
dietary.lactoseFreeDesc: No lactose — the sugar in milk. Hard cheeses and lactose-free dairy are typically fine.
dietary.milkProteinFreeDesc: No casein or whey proteins found in milk products.
dietary.nutFreeDesc: No tree nuts such as almonds, walnuts, cashews, hazelnuts, or pistachios.
dietary.peanutFreeDesc: No peanuts or peanut-based products. Note: peanuts are legumes, not tree nuts.
dietary.soyFreeDesc: No soy or soy-derived ingredients, including tofu, edamame, and soy sauce.
dietary.shellfishFreeDesc: No crustaceans or molluscs — shrimp, crab, lobster, mussels, squid, and similar.
dietary.sesameFreeDesc: No sesame seeds or sesame oil, including tahini.
dietary.halalDesc: Prepared according to Islamic dietary law. No pork, no alcohol, halal-certified meat only.
dietary.kosherDesc: Prepared according to Jewish dietary law. No pork, no shellfish, no mixing of meat and dairy.
dietary.ketoDesc: Very low in carbohydrates, high in fat. Keeps the body in a state of ketosis.
dietary.lowGiDesc: Prioritises foods that release energy slowly, avoiding sharp blood sugar spikes.
dietary.lowFodmapDesc: Avoids fermentable carbohydrates that can cause digestive discomfort. Often recommended for IBS.
dietary.paleoDesc: Based on whole, unprocessed foods. No grains, legumes, dairy, or refined sugar.

planting.ariaLabel: Walnut planting animation — progress through the planting sequence

steps.0: Hand visible above the soil, holding a walnut
steps.1: A hole is dug in the soil; the hand lowers
steps.2: The walnut is placed in the hole
steps.3: A first handful of soil covers the walnut
steps.4: The soil mound is formed and patted down
steps.5: A small wooden name stake is placed beside the mound
steps.6: Small details appear around the scene — stones, a leaf, the soil moistens
steps.7: A watering can tips over the mound; first drops fall
steps.8: The soil is dark and moist — the seed is fully planted
steps.9: Mag stage complete — the walnut is in the ground
steps.10: Csemete — two cotyledon leaves push above the soil
